labyrint.title: Labyrinth Mariozo 🌀 Maze Obby
labyrint.description:
Dark maze, one torch, one way out.

Every level comes out of one world seed, so level 40 is the same maze for you as for me. That is the only reason the medal times mean anything.

🔥 Lava pulses. 3 seconds safe, 0.8 flashing yellow, then 2.2 that kill you. First one on level 6. It used to sit on the only route and never switch off, and a player got walled in and quit. My fix, and the best thing in here
👹 Monsters cap at speed 15. You walk 16, so you can always outrun one
🔓 Hit a coloured button and the wall in that colour drops into the floor
🏁 Touch the green EXIT and the next maze builds around you

Par is the walk from start to exit. Diamond is par x 1.3, same for everyone. Top 3 times per level across every server.

🛒 Perks: torch 300, extra life 600, speed 500, minimap 800
🎨 17 wall themes. Classic is free. Nothing costs Robux
🎁 Daily login pays 150 coins, 1050 on day 7

Built by an uncle and his nephew.

Can you clear level 50?

crystal.title: Grow a Crystal 💎 (Cavern Idle)
crystal.description:
Plant a seed-crystal in a socket. Click it again when it has finished growing. A Shard takes 60 seconds. A Mythic seed takes 40 minutes and keeps growing while you are logged out.

The harvest is the gacha. Every crystal rolls refraction, one tier up per hit, stopping at the first miss: Shard, Quartz, Amethyst, Prism, Legendary, Mythic.

💎 Mythic out of a plain Shard is 1 in 4,329 at Luck 0. About 1 in 58 at Luck 10
💎 A Shard seed costs 10 Dust and pays back 7.8 on average, so it loses money until you own the first Luck level
💎 6 sockets per chamber, up to 48. Dust also buys Luck and Growth
💎 Codex counts to 6/6. The top 10 Dust board refreshes every 30 seconds

Codes: WELCOME, CRYSTAL, GEODE, MYTHIC. One Geode a week for 1,000 Dust, rotating Prism, Legendary, Mythic.

Alpha, built solo, code only. The refraction roll is the good part and the one thing I would defend.

Is 1 in 4,329 too stingy at Luck 0?

plus1.title: +1 Jump Every Step 🔼 Sky Temple Obby
plus1.description:
You start with a normal 7.2 stud jump. Every platform past the highest one you have reached gives +1 Jump Power, and each point is +0.6 studs of height. Six platforms per tier.

One catch: the +1 only fires past your highest. Skip a platform, come back later, and it pays nothing.

🏛 Everyone in the server climbs the same tower, seed 20260905
⬇ Fall and you are put back on the platform you last earned. Nothing lost
♻ REBIRTH at tier 10, then 18, then 26. Multipliers 2x to 100x, on jump HEIGHT only - you still earn +1 per platform
🏆 The top 10 board is your best tier ever and survives a rebirth

No kill bricks, no lava. You cannot die in this game at all.

Step height stops at tier 17, jump height caps at 60 studs. Above that it is the same climb forever, which is the point.

🎁 Codes: WELCOME, SKYHIGH, TEMPLE, LAUNCH. LAUNCH alone is +100 Jump Power

Built solo, code only.

Is tier 10 too long a first climb before rebirth unlocks?

anomaly.title: Anomaly: Night Shift at the Observatory 🔭
anomaly.description:
Nothing chases you. The hall is rebuilt before every pass, and either it is clean or exactly one thing is wrong.

Walk the 80 studs and look at everything. E to ADVANCE if it looked clean, Q to TURN BACK if you caught it. Right call is Day +1. A wrong one puts you back on Day 1, no matter how deep.

H at the start pad spends a hint token. It only tells you clean or not clean, never which one.

Day 1 draws from the 8 obvious ones. A new type joins every 2 days, all 24 by Day 33. Anomaly chance starts at 50% and stops at 62% on Day 31. Miss one and the game names what you walked past.

The Watcher stands at the far end facing you. The Climber is upside down on the ceiling halfway along. Both have a red light where the face should be.

⚠ No sound yet. The wrong-call scare is a red flash and a camera shake
🎁 Code WELCOME for 3 hint tokens
🔦 Turn the graphics up. It is meant to be that dark

Is 50% on Day 1 too generous?

horror, spot the difference, anomaly, night shift, observatory
